scoring_justification: Recompute of λ and Tc from raw Eliashberg function not possible as output contract only provides final aggregated results; scoring based on result-level comparison of reported numbers against paper gold with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for Tc and lambda from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: JETP Letters 80, 623 (2004). Tc ambient = 11.1 K, Tc 15% compression = 4.9 K, Tc 30% compression = 0.98 K, λ_ac = 0.71, λ_op = 0.21.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the exact results reported in the paper.

outputs.description: Electron-phonon coupling constants (acoustic and optical) at equilibrium volume V0, and superconducting critical temperatures Tc at three volumes (V0, 0.85V0, 0.70V0). The checker compares these values to hidden gold with tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The task reproduces the electron-phonon coupling constants and Tc of NbC using first-principles DFT/DFPT. The agent must run the four process steps to obtain the Eliashberg functions, then compute the scored quantities. The scored artifact results.json contains all required numbers.
